info.title: Spinroom API
info.description: One API for the web app, MCP server, Slack app and future native clients.

get.summary: Begin Spotify PKCE login with the user’s own Client ID (option B).
Login configuration for the setup screen.

post.summary: Development only (SPOTIFY_MODE=fake): sign in as a fake Spotify user.
Rotate the refresh token and mint a new access token.
End the current session.
Internal: Slack or MCP service exchanges a linked identity for a short-lived user token.

delete.summary: Delete my account and personal data.

get.summary: Short-lived Spotify access token for the speaker page (origin-checked).

put.summary: Choose a preset or one of my custom avatars.

get.summary: My Spotify playlists, for linking a set.

post.summary: Link a Slack identity using a signed link from the Slack app.

get.summary: My rooms or the public directory, with live counts.

post.summary: Create a room.

patch.summary: Edit room name, description, visibility or settings (owner/moderator).

delete.summary: Delete a room for good (owner): members, invites, sets, history and chat. Spotify playlists are kept.

post.summary: Close a room (owner): stops playback, sends everyone out and hides it. The owner can reopen it.
Reopen a closed room (owner).
Join a room (and mark present). Invite-only rooms need an invite token or membership.
Leave a room: drops presence, the booth and the DJ queue.
One-time ticket (30 s) for opening the live socket from another origin: wss://…/v1/rooms/{slug}/live?ticket=…
Create an invite link.

get.summary: Room shown on an invite landing page.

post.summary: Join a room via invite.
Add a track by URI or by search query (first result). Appends to the linked playlist.

patch.summary: Move a track to a new position.

post.summary: Link a Spotify playlist as my set, create a "Spinroom – <room>" playlist, or import read-only.
Join the DJ queue (needs ≥ 1 playable track in my set).

delete.summary: Leave the DJ queue or step down from the booth.

put.summary: Cast or change a vote (`current` allowed as spinId). Votes are visible in aggregate.

post.summary: Skip the current spin (its DJ or a moderator).

get.summary: Who voted what on the current spin (moderators only, FR-V6).

post.summary: Send a chat message (visible to the room).
Toggle an emoji reaction.
Kick, ban, mute, end spin, set role, hide avatar.

get.summary: Spotify track search (proxied with my token, cached 10 minutes).

post.summary: Register a speaker for a room. One live speaker per member per room.
Report speaker state, position and drift every 15 s.
Create a personal API token (for the stdio MCP server). Shown once.

delete.summary: Revoke a personal API token or MCP connection.

post.summary: One-time code for `npx spinroom-mcp login <code>`.
Exchange a one-time code for a personal API token.

get.summary: A pending MCP authorization request, shown on the consent screen.

post.summary: Approve or deny an MCP authorization request.
Import a ChatGPT pet (sprite kit zip, single sheet, or pet.json + sheet). Multipart.

get.summary: An avatar (pending ones only for their owner).

delete.summary: Delete one of my custom avatars.

post.summary: Report an avatar to the global review queue.
Approve, reject or remove an avatar everywhere.
